instructions: Calm, clear, warm American female teacher. Steady medium pace, friendly and unhurried. A short pause before each number. Plain American English.

scenes.vo: Every time you stream, search, or ask an AI, you are renting a computer in a giant building.
scenes.caption: Every time you stream, search, or ask an AI, you are renting a computer in a giant building.

scenes.vo: Land, power, a building, chips, a network, and software. Rented out by the hour, or by contract.
scenes.caption: Land, power, a building, chips, a network, and software. Rented out by the hour, or by contract.

scenes.vo: It is a huge business. Cloud rental earns five hundred fifty-eight billion dollars a year, growing fifty-five percent. About two point four nine trillion more is already signed, in backlog.
scenes.caption: It is a huge business. Cloud rental earns $558 billion a year, growing 55 percent. About $2.49 trillion more is already signed, in backlog.

scenes.vo: Now the bill. Five companies spent two hundred thirty point four billion dollars in one quarter. One gigawatt campus costs about fifty-two point six billion, as an illustration.
scenes.caption: Now the bill. Five companies spent $230.4 billion in one quarter. One gigawatt campus costs about $52.6 billion, as an illustration.

scenes.vo: Here is the catch. Chips wear out in about six years. At today's GPU cloud prices, a campus barely breaks even, and borrowing makes it worse.
scenes.caption: Here is the catch. Chips wear out in about six years. At today's GPU cloud prices, a campus barely breaks even, and borrowing makes it worse.

scenes.vo: So who keeps the money? Chip makers. NVIDIA's operating margin is sixty-six percent. The big clouds make thirty-six to thirty-nine percent. GPU clouds, zero or less.
scenes.caption: So who keeps the money? Chip makers. NVIDIA's operating margin is 66 percent. The big clouds make 36 to 39 percent. GPU clouds, zero or less.

scenes.vo: The question is not whether AI is real. It is whether revenue per gigawatt outruns depreciation and interest.
